get.description:
Every implementation allowed by a loaded pipeline, with its deployment setting.
An implementation without a setting row is disabled.

schema.title: Response List Implementations Api V1 Admin Implementations Get

put.description:
Enable or disable an implementation and optionally make it the slot's default.
Making one the default clears the default of the slot's other implementations.

get.description:
Every preset offered by a loaded pipeline version, with its deployment setting.
A preset without a setting row is disabled.

schema.title: Response List Presets Api V1 Admin Presets Get

put.description:
Enable or disable a preset and optionally make it the pipeline's default (at most
one; it replaces the previous one). Disabling only hides the preset from new runs:
runs already created keep their plan and can be resumed.

schema.title: Response List Cases Api V1 Cases Get

delete.description:
Soft-delete the case and remove its files. Refused while a run is active or when
the case is flagged keep-forever.

patch.description:
Edit ``sex`` and ``age_band`` (null clears); ``keep_forever`` is for administrators.
Existing runs keep the values frozen at their creation.

schema.title: Response List Inputs Api V1 Cases  Case Id  Inputs Get

patch.description:
Change or clear the declared origin of an input without uploading it again.
Same rule and lock as replacing the file: refused once the case has a run.

put.description:
Upload or replace the input of one role (for example ``ct``, ``lesion_native``,
``lesion_mni``), before the first run. 201 for a new role, 200 for a replacement.

``origin`` is an optional JSON object declaring how a supplied file was made
(``{"kind": "manual"}`` or ``{"kind": "external-tool", "tool", "version"}``). It is
stored as declared and never verified; a replacement without ``origin`` clears the
previous declaration, since it described the previous file.

schema.title: Response List Case Runs Api V1 Cases  Case Id  Runs Get

post.description:
Resolve the pipeline against the case's inputs, validate the per-slot choices
(422 when a choice is not enabled), store the run as ``queued`` and enqueue it.

Without ``preset`` and ``targets`` the run gets the full plan; ``preset`` runs a
reviewed preset; ``targets`` (free mode, 403 unless the deployment's
``RUN_PLAN_POLICY`` allows it to the caller) builds a plan from the outputs wanted.
Refusals carry every reason in ``reasons`` (run-plans.md 3.3).

get.description:
The deployment profile, its run-plan policy and whether the caller may use free
mode, so that the UI does not offer it in vain.

schema.title: Response List Pipelines Api V1 Pipelines Get

post.description:
Dry run of run creation: the plan the request would get, with the same policy
checks (403 ``free_mode_not_allowed`` for targets when the policy does not allow
them to this user) and the same plan as ``POST /cases/{id}/runs`` for the same
request. A refused plan is a 200 with ``feasible: false`` and every reason; only a
malformed request (unknown slot or input role, inputs matching no input set) is a
422. Nothing is written.

get.description:
Presets attached to this pipeline version that are enabled in the deployment:
title, accepted input sets, the plan per input set (slots, roles, implementations)
and ``available`` with the reasons when the deployment cannot run it now (for
example a required slot has no enabled implementation). Several versions of one
preset are all listed, ascending.

schema.title: Response List Presets Api V1 Pipelines  Pipeline Id  Versions  Version  Presets Get

get.description: Slots of a pipeline with their enabled implementations and the default of each.

schema.title: Response List Slots Api V1 Pipelines  Pipeline Id  Versions  Version  Slots Get

get.description:
Status, slot choices (implementation, image digest, parameters, bundles) and the
step timeline (one entry per attempt).

schema.title: Response List Artifacts Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Artifacts Get

post.description:
Idempotent (docs/data-model.md 7.3): 200 when the run is canceled, 202 while a
running run is asked to stop, 409 ``run_not_active`` for a finished run.

schema.title: Response List Reports Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Reports Get

post.description:
Resume a failed or canceled run from its failed step: succeeded slots are kept,
the seed, choices, parameters and bundles stay those of the run. 202 when queued,
200 when the run is already active; refusals are 409 with the codes of data-model.md 7.3.
Alias of ``resume`` ("retry from the failed step" is the same operation).

schema.title: Response List Steps Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Steps Get

get.description:
The last ``tail_bytes`` of the attempt's log. ``X-Log-Truncated: true`` when the
start is missing (cut here or by the orchestrator).
